english.title: Fail to set vehicle handbrake / restraining device when on part of Manchester Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), caused or permitted a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be left unattended on part of Manchester Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF MANCHESTER AIRPORT..), when the parking brake or restraining device with which the vehicle was equipped was not properly engaged
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 2.2 and 5.3 of the Manchester Airport Byelaws 2024.
